$comment: The design system's two kits as the app vendors them. Update with `node scripts/kits.mjs <maps|figures> <file> --source "…"`; `npm run check:runtime` (checks/runtime/kits.test.mjs) refuses a file that does not match. GM.md, "The kits".

maps.source: Blades '68 Design System, map kit 0.9.0, plus app-side changes: front vector room, roll w/lvl, kit 1.0 the grand map (src/grand.js, ticket 2.1), a room's own arch (the lair, ticket 5.4) and blueprint rooms on the player copy (opts.blueprint, ticket 2.2); take upstream

figures.note: 3.0.1 carries the arm blend (pose.arms.R = { a, b, t, as }, used by tools/ambient/motion.js) in the kit, so the app's local patch (6474342, PR #53) is dropped; it draws the same as the patched 3.0.0. The pages load this full build, not figure-kit.min.js: the minified one draws the same but leaves out each part's params and describe, which the character creator reads (app/core.js, app/steps.js: the Parting, Volume, Length, hat Band and prop-side controls, and the part tooltips)
